propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids (e.g., G6, F1, E2) inline but have no mechanism to detect when a criterion's authoritative registry text diverges from the guide's claim about it, leaving semantic drift invisible.

The existing validate_criteria_guide() scoped only to the generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md does not cover hand-authored guides, and test_guides.py couples guides only to coach_moves.MOVE_REGISTRY, leaving 19 of 20 criteria cited in the plan guide with no drift coupling.
A new gate must convert invisible semantic drift into visible, forced re-verification by pinning a digest of each cited criterion's registry text and failing when the digest diverges.

The pin manifest must be derived and regenerated separately from the prose guides (which are never rewritten), keying only on closed criterion-id vocabulary matched at word boundaries, so ordinary prose edits do not break the gate.
The gate must report four classes of failure: unknown citations (id not in registry), stale pins (cited criterion text changed), orphan pins (pinned id no longer cited), and missing manifest.
The gate must compose into the existing validate-routing step in CI without adding a new workflow task, and all src/rebar files must respect the 800-LOC cap.
